note: Named bundles of director's notes. A film wears one with "look_template": "<id>"; studio/_tools/directions.py applies it. The individual notes live in studio/directions/.

product_daylight.name: Product, daylight
product_daylight.for: a thing on a table, in a kitchen, in daylight. The default for commercials.

outdoor_hero.name: Outdoor hero
outdoor_hero.for: gear, movement, landscape. Reach for figure_in_landscape as the hero shot - it is the one named best across five reviews.

moody_hook.name: Moody hook
moody_hook.for: a teaser that wants unease. The ONLY look that should be dark, and it must be dark on purpose - set night true and say so.
moody_hook.warning: day-for-night costs saturation 0.72 and brightness -0.15. Six hook films measured under luma 64 for their whole runtime wearing it by accident. Choose it, do not inherit it.
